2609.18440.title: Planning or Improvisation? Stress-Testing the Poetry Planning Site on Open Models and Open Cross-Layer Transcoders
2609.18440.paper_summary: Lindsey et al. (2025) report that Claude 3.5 Haiku plans rhymes: features for candidate rhyme words are active on the newline before a line is written, and a suppress-and-inject intervention redirects the line only when applied there (their Figure 13). We test how far this generalizes on seven cells crossing four open models (0.6B to 2.6B parameters) with six open cross-layer transcoders (CLTs), on one consumer GPU, decomposing the claim into position specificity (C1), newline site identity (C2), and a newline-resident plan (C3). This is a stress test rather than a faithful reproduction: attribution graphs are unavailable for these CLTs, so features are found bottom-up from decoder vectors. C1 generalizes, in every cell and in all 247 of 444 prompt-by-inject pairs with a detectable effect, but the effective position is the final prompt token, adjacent to emission, and only two cells reach behaviorally meaningful probabilities. C2 and C3 are not recovered by any probe: a census of every active feature finds no rhyme-anticipating enrichment at the newline, and steering the newline while the model composes the whole line, over 36 runs and 8,640 sampled lines, shows why. That intervention is strong but one token long, making the injected word the first word of the composed line in 703 of 720 samples and leaving the rhyme six words later untouched. A final test drops the transcoder entirely: patching the newline's whole residual, at every layer, from a minimal-pair poem whose third line ends on a different rhyme moves the rhyme in 11 of 1,260 composed lines against 4 at baseline, with a design resolving 1.4%. We read this as a boundary condition rather than a refutation: at this scale and with these transcoders, the causal site is emission-adjacent. We reproduce Figure 13's shape, not its mechanism. Code and data are public (code: github.com/PCfVW/poetry-planning-site).
2609.18440.paper_summary_zh: Lindsey 等人 (2025) 報告指出 Claude 3.5 Haiku 計劃押韻：候選押韻詞的特徵在寫入行之前的換行上是活躍的，而一種抑制與注入的干預僅在應用於該處時才會重新導向該行（他們的圖 13）。我們測試這一點在七個單元中如何推廣，跨越四個開放模型（0.6B 到 2.6B 參數），使用六個開放的跨層轉碼器 (CLTs)，在一個消費者 GPU 上，將該主張分解為位置特異性 (C1)、換行位置身份 (C2) 和一個換行常駐計劃 (C3)。這是一個壓力測試，而不是忠實的重現：這些 CLTs 的歸因圖不可用，因此特徵是從解碼器向量自下而上找到的。C1 在每個單元和所有 444 個提示與注入對中有可檢測的效果的 247 個中都能推廣，但有效的位置是最終的提示標記，與發射相鄰，只有兩個單元達到行為上有意義的概率。C2 和 C3 沒有被任何探針恢復：對每個活躍特徵的普查在換行處未發現任何押韻預測的豐富性，而在模型構成整行時引導換行，經過 36 次運行和 8,640 行樣本，顯示了原因。該干預強大但只有一個標記長，這使得注入的詞在 720 個樣本中的 703 個中成為構成行的第一個詞，並且使得押韻在六個詞之後未受影響。最後一個測試完全去掉轉碼器：從一首第三行以不同押韻結束的最小對詩中修補換行的整個殘差，在 1,260 行構成的行中移動押韻的次數為 11 次，而基線為 4 次，設計解決率為 1.4%。我們將此視為邊界條件而非反駁：在這一規模和這些轉碼器下，因果位置是與發射相鄰的。我們重現了圖 13 的形狀，而不是其機制。代碼和數據是公開的（代碼：github.com/PCfVW/poetry-planning-site）。
2609.18440.author: Éric Jacopin et.al.
